title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the ground state energy must be correctly stated as E'_{11} = (pi^2 * hbar^2)/(m * L^2) + (3a)/(2L).

title: Initial Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the initial ground state energy E_{11} must be correctly derived as (hbar^2 * pi^2)/(m * L^2).

title: Perturbation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The perturbation Hamiltonian H' = a * delta(x1 - x2) must be correctly identified and set up.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The evaluation of the integral for the correction to the energy must be correctly performed, leading to the term (3a)/(2L).

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the final expression should be checked for consistency, ensuring energy units are correct.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the perturbation term or the final energy expression.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that no factors are omitted in the calculation of the integral or the final energy expression.
